# API Reference

Use this reference to locate code and check selected call signatures. These are application internals, not a promised stable third-party API. Start with the [Developer Guide](Developer-Guide.md) for setup and changes, or [Architecture Overview](Architecture-Overview.md) for data flow.

The module inventory follows `pyproject.toml`. Explanations are curated; declarations and source links are read from the current source without importing Qt. Only selected methods are shown. Private attributes and inherited Qt methods are intentionally omitted.

## Modules

| Module | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| [`Icescopy`](API-Module-Icescopy.md) | Application startup, main window, and coordination of session state and tools. |
| [`icescopy_analysis_windows`](API-Module-icescopy-analysis-windows.md) | Convert start/end markers into inclusive frame ranges. |
| [`icescopy_aux`](API-Module-icescopy-aux.md) | Viewer input handling, analysis worker, and preference dialogs. |

## Keeping this reference current

Edit `tools/api_reference.json` when responsibilities or selected entry points change, then run:

```sh
python tools/update_api_reference.py
python tools/update_api_reference.py --check
python tools/wiki_docs.py check
```

The first command refreshes these API pages; `--check` reports drift without writing. Do not edit generated pages directly. Narrative architecture and developer pages are maintained separately. See [Documentation Guide](Documentation-Guide.md) for wiki publication.
